_comment: Coder backend registry for coder_dispatch.py. EVERY backend is wired here even if its CLI is not installed yet — set enabled:true and drop the binary in, and it activates automatically (availability is detected at runtime). See docs/HEALTH_AGENT.md. No hardcoded values in code: all backends, paths, priorities and routing live here. Override per-key via config_documents table key 'coder_backends'.

backends.name: claude_code
backends.notes: Strongest at multi-file repo edits. Already used by claude_escalation_handler tier-3.

backends.name: cursor_agent
backends.notes: Cursor headless agent. Edits files in the worktree cwd.

backends.name: grok_cli
backends.notes: xAI Grok agent CLI. Free OIDC auth lane.

backends.name: chatgpt_codex_proxy
backends.notes: Free ChatGPT/Codex OAuth proxy. Returns a unified diff which the dispatcher git-applies in the worktree.

backends.name: grok_proxy
backends.notes: Free Grok OAuth proxy. Returns a unified diff which the dispatcher git-applies.

backends.name: codex_cli
backends.notes: DORMANT — codex CLI not installed yet. OpenAI's standalone Codex agent; good for focused single/multi-file code edits.

backends.name: aider
backends.notes: DORMANT — aider not installed yet. Pair-programming CLI; strong at incremental single-file diffs.
backends.install: pipx install aider-chat  (then it activates automatically)

routing._comment: Map a problem 'kind' to an ordered preference of backend names. The router walks the list and picks the first AVAILABLE + enabled backend. Falls back to '_default' then to global priority order.
